title: Deploying to static hosting
content: The generated .output/public folder can be served by any static host. Because each doc becomes its own HTML file, crawlers get full content and each thread has a stable, deep-linkable URL.

replies.content: Does the PWA service worker cache all the docs for offline?
Yes — workbox globPatterns precaches the html/css/js, so the site is usable offline as a PWA.
Good, that means the whole static output is the PWA.
